title: APS AutoCAD cloud route for a bounded AC1027 Sweep witness
scope: Find a producer-backed path for one minimal AC1027 SweptSurface DWG and paired DXF when no local AutoCAD 2013/ObjectARX host is available.

officialEvidence.source: Autodesk Platform Services Automation API overview
officialEvidence.finding: The Automation API runs scripts and plugins against AutoCAD engines using AppBundles, Activities, and WorkItems; Autodesk publishes an AutoCAD-specific CRX walkthrough.

officialEvidence.source: Autodesk AutoCAD 2027 Automation engine release note
officialEvidence.finding: The current AutoCAD engine alias is Autodesk.AutoCAD+26_0. Its plugin environment supports .NET 10 and the 2027 ObjectARX toolchain. This is a current AutoCAD producer, not AutoCAD 2013.

officialEvidence.source: Autodesk AutoCAD .NET SweptSurface and SweepOptionsBuilder references
officialEvidence.finding: The managed API wraps AcDbSweptSurface, exposes its SweepOptions, and provides options for alignment, banking, base point, transforms, draft, scale, and twist. CreateSweptSurface accepts explicit sweep and path entities plus options.
The database APIs can write both DWG and DXF with an explicit version; their documented version lists include AC1027 / AutoCAD 2013.

officialEvidence.source: APS service access and WorkItem cost notes
officialEvidence.finding: The free APS tier has monthly limits and requires a payment method for identity verification; the official WorkItem tutorial states that executing a job has a cost.

conditionalWorkflow: If an APS developer app and authorized quota are already available, build a minimal AutoCAD 2027 .NET 10 AppBundle using the documented SweptSurface and SweepOptionsBuilder APIs.

Create two sweeps in one drawing: a baseline/default case and one deliberately distinct non-default option case. Record source entity geometry, handles, all option getter values, engine alias, AppBundle hash, Activity, WorkItem ID, and worker logs.

Save the database as AC1027 DWG and emit a paired AC1027 DXF. Reopen the saved AC1027 DWG in the same worker and record the getters and entity relationships again. Verify the DWG magic and DXF $ACADVER independently from API state.

Keep generated files in scratch. Compare paired DXF, ODA v5.4.1, and source-bound local/peer cursor traces for field spans, handles, suffix bytes, and following-frame alignment. Preserve unresolved suffix bytes and keep strict output refused until the wire spans are proven.

profileBoundary.validUse: A current AutoCAD 2027 producer writing the AC1027 file format, with source API state and a matching AC1027 DXF.
profileBoundary.notEquivalentTo: A drawing authored by the AutoCAD 2013 product release. Do not transfer this route's producer behavior or API defaults to that release.
profileBoundary.gateEffect: Can admit a separate AC1027-format/current-producer profile if all source, span, graph, output, and semantic gates pass; does not automatically close P4-C or promote a general AC1027 claim.

executionBoundary.reason: No APS credentials or authorized service quota were available in this workspace. WorkItem execution may incur cost; no account, quota, or paid service was used.
executionBoundary.resumeWhen: Use only when the user has an APS developer app and authorizes the available quota/cost; otherwise continue waiting for the local AutoCAD/ObjectARX witness route.

limitations: Documentation confirms the APIs and versioned save routes but does not prove the actual cloud engine can create this exact Sweep profile; first run must verify the plugin loads and both source entities/options survive save and reopen.
A current engine saving AC1027 is a separate producer profile from AutoCAD 2013, even when both use the AC1027 file format.
No witness bytes, semantic result, parser span, or support claim was produced by this research.

planImpact.completedSlice: P4-C APS cloud-authoring route and its producer/version/cost limits are documented.
planImpact.remainingP4C: Generate and qualify a producer-bound AC1027 witness; use the APS route only with authorized credentials and quota, and preserve its current-producer profile boundary.
